item.title: Pay Per Call Affiliate Payouts: How to Automate Them
item.description:
Affiliate payout disputes rarely start with the money. They start with two different counts of the same calls.
If you pay affiliates for calls, a few habits make payouts far less painful:
- Give every affiliate their own tracking number, so each call is attributed the moment it arrives. - Set the payout rate per affiliate in the system, not in an email thread. - Write down what makes a call payable: minimum length, location, repeat callers, blocked numbers. - Let affiliates see their own calls and earnings, so they don't have to ask you for a number. - Settle buyer disputes from the call record before you pay out, not after.
None of this removes disagreements. It moves them to the start of the relationship, where they're cheap to settle, instead of month-end, where they aren't.
The full routine, including where call quality fits into who gets paid, is in the article:
#PayPerCall #AffiliateMarketing #CallTracking
https://insightdial.com/blog/pay-per-call-affiliate-payouts

item.title: Pay Per Call Campaign Setup: Step by Step
item.description:
The most expensive test call is the one a real customer makes for you.
Before a pay-per-call campaign goes live, one habit saves a lot of arguments: write down what a payable call is, then check your setup against that sentence.
A quick version: - What is the minimum call length? - Which states or countries count? - What hours and daily caps does the buyer want? - Which numbers and repeat callers are excluded? - Does each traffic source have its own tracking number and payout rate?
If the answer to any of those lives only in someone's head or in a chat thread, it will get applied differently by different people. Put it in the campaign settings instead.
Then call every tracking number yourself. Check the call lands with the right buyer, is credited to the right source, and shows up in your records. It takes a few minutes, and it's far cheaper than finding the problem after a day of live traffic.
The full step-by-step setup order is here, including routing choices and a launch-day checklist:
#PayPerCall #CallTracking #AffiliateMarketing
https://insightdial.com/blog/pay-per-call-campaign-setup
